description: Type ACL metadata survives catalog materialization, revoke/grant and rollback
cleanup_sql: DROP TYPE IF EXISTS audit_acl_state CASCADE
sql: SELECT typacl IS NULL AS implicit_acl FROM pg_type WHERE typname='audit_acl_state'
REVOKE USAGE ON TYPE audit_acl_state FROM PUBLIC
SELECT typacl IS NULL AS implicit_acl FROM pg_type WHERE typname='audit_acl_state'
GRANT USAGE ON TYPE audit_acl_state TO audit_acl_reader
SELECT typacl IS NOT NULL AS explicit_acl FROM pg_type WHERE typname='audit_acl_state'
SELECT typacl IS NOT NULL AS explicit_acl FROM pg_type WHERE FALSE
REVOKE USAGE ON TYPE audit_acl_state FROM audit_acl_reader
